response.sql: WITH station_counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_band_usage_pct FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation) SELECT observstation, avg_band_usage_pct, telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(telescope_count) FROM station_counts) AS telescope_count_ratio FROM station_counts ORDER BY telescope_count_ratio DESC LIMIT 10;
